    32→// VerifyDataColumnSidecar verifies if the data column sidecar is valid.
    33→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar
    34→func VerifyDataColumnSidecar(sidecar blocks.RODataColumn) error {
    35→	// The sidecar index must be within the valid range.
    36→	if sidecar.Index >= fieldparams.NumberOfColumns {
    37→		return ErrIndexTooLarge
    38→	}
    39→
    40→	// A sidecar for zero blobs is invalid.
    41→	if len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) == 0 {

    44→
    45→	// A sidecar with more commitments than the max blob count for this block is invalid.

    47→	maxBlobsPerBlock := params.BeaconConfig().MaxBlobsPerBlock(slot)

    50→	}
    51→
    52→	// The column length must be equal to the number of commitments/proofs.
    53→	if len(sidecar.Column) != len(sidecar.KzgCommitments) || len(sidecar.Column) != len(sidecar.KzgProofs) {
    54→		return ErrMismatchLength
    55→	}
    56→
    57→	return nil
    58→}

    60→// VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs verifies if the KZG proofs are correct.
    61→// Note: We are slightly deviating from the specification here:
    62→// The specification verifies the KZG proofs for each sidecar separately,
    63→// while we are verifying all the KZG proofs from multiple sidecars in a batch.
    64→// This is done to improve performance since the internal KZG library is way more
    65→// efficient when verifying in batch.
    66→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs
    67→func VerifyDataColumnsSidecarKZGProofs(sidecars []blocks.RODataColumn) error {

    72→	}

    75→	indices := make([]uint64, 0, count)
    76→	cells := make([]kzg.Cell, 0, count)

    98→			copy(cell[:], cellBytes)
    99→			copy(proof[:], proofBytes)

   102→			indices = append(indices, sidecar.Index)
   103→			cells = append(cells, cell)
   104→			proofs = append(proofs, proof)
   105→		}
   106→	}

   109→	verified, err := kzg.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch(commitments, indices, cells, proofs)
   110→	if err != nil {

   112→	}
   113→
   114→	if !verified {
   115→		return ErrInvalidKZGProof
   116→	}
   117→
   118→	return nil
   119→}

   121→// VerifyDataColumnSidecarInclusionProof verifies if the given KZG commitments included in the given beacon block.
   122→// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/p2p-interface.md#verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof
   123→func VerifyDataColumnSidecarInclusionProof(sidecar blocks.RODataColumn) error {
   124→	if sidecar.SignedBlockHeader == nil || sidecar.SignedBlockHeader.Header == nil {
   125→		return ErrNilBlockHeader
   126→	}
   127→
   128→	root := sidecar.SignedBlockHeader.Header.BodyRoot

   136→	if err != nil {
